pr_title: Index variant bands by lens name

comments.comment: Indexing bands by name lets the docs variant overwrite the payments variant. The change replaces selection with name as the map key, although folder variants may share a name. Both declared variants then read the last band.
comments.failureScenario: The two correctness variants in src/review.ts have bands { floor: 2, ceiling: 3 } for payments and { floor: 1, ceiling: 1 } for docs. bandFor(variants, variants[0]) now returns the docs band for payments because both map entries use the name correctness.
